misconceptions: taking logs of a sum as a sum of logs
practice: State the inverse of exponential growth.
Use log laws to combine terms.
Why check a solution in original equation.

videoPackage.transcript: We compare function families, use inverse operations carefully, and respect domain restrictions when solving.

videoPackage.title: Instantaneous change
